package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

// Negative (wrong-status): a field read through a nil pointer to an
// imported struct type is the nil dereference Go reports, recovered as a
// runtime.Error.
func main() {
	defer func() {
		r := recover()
		_, isRuntime := r.(runtime.Error)
		fmt.Println(isRuntime, r)
	}()
	var p *runtime.MemStats
	fmt.Println(p.Alloc)
}
